content.title: Plug Power Stock Tumbles on Plan to Raise Capital
content.summary: The wild ride for  Plug Power  investors continues.  Shares of the hydrogen technology provider plunged 20% in premarket trading to $1.71 after the company announced a capital raise on Tuesday evening.  Plug Power said it would offer $375 million of convertible notes, which can become more shares outstanding.
